author: jonny676
body:
Honestly, try focusing on getting enough orns to get to nekro. I played through the mage line and also found archdruid to be extremely underwhelming, but then nekro changed all of that. 

Also, are you using a fully buffed sorrow? Sorrow should hit pretty hard against most things, unless it's not fully maxed out.

Personally, I used a dragon scroll instead of a shield at t8. However, this was before dual wielding was a thing. Do you have a better staff that you could use? This one isn't really doing a whole lot for you tbh. 

As others have mentioned, your specialization could probably use a changing. Berzerker was recommended, but if you want to go full magic then Magus is also a good choice. This will give you access to great meditation, which can be a hit or a miss but is generally still useful. 

What are you using for skills? I see you have ring of day equipped, so i'm guessing you must be using jinn's talent at minimum?
